_source: City of Burton BS&A Assessing database (D001City Of Burton 2026), read-only aggregate export. Residential = property class 401. Sales = assessor terms code 03 (arm's length), price over 10,000 dollars, by calendar year of sale.
_utility_source: City of Burton BS&A Utility Billing database (D010BURTON), read-only aggregate export. Residential active accounts on quarterly cycles with four bills in the window; split by whether any water item was billed.

utility.window: four quarterly bills posted in the 12 months before extraction
